published.title: Opposition and Delay
published.summary: Opponents offer to help rebuild the temple, are refused, and obstruct the work. The chapter also recounts later letters that lead Artaxerxes to stop work on Jerusalem’s city; it closes by returning to the temple work halted until Darius’s reign.
